teachingCards.title: Standard Collocations

teachingCards.title: Scholarly Context
teachingCards.content: Scientists found a possible LINK between poor air quality and rising childhood asthma rates.

quests.definition: To change gradually in order to suit new conditions.
quests.passage: Companies that fail to ADAPT to changing consumer habits often lose market share within a few years.
quests.example: Companies that fail to ADAPT to changing consumer habits often lose market share within a few years.
quests.exampleSentence: Companies that fail to ADAPT to changing consumer habits often lose market share within a few years.
quests.contextSentence: Companies that fail to ADAPT to changing consumer habits often lose market share within a few years.
quests.explanation: ADAPT describes companies adjusting to new conditions, distinct from simply advertising more, merging with rivals, or liquidating entirely.
quests.casualVsAcademic: Casual: Look over / talk about | Academic: ADAPT (Business)
quests.nativeTip: Frequently used in scholarly articles and academic journals across Business.

quests.definition: To rise and fall irregularly in level or amount.
quests.passage: Currency values can FLUCTUATE sharply within a single trading day in response to political news.
quests.example: Currency values can FLUCTUATE sharply within a single trading day in response to political news.
quests.exampleSentence: Currency values can FLUCTUATE sharply within a single trading day in response to political news.
quests.contextSentence: Currency values can FLUCTUATE sharply within a single trading day in response to political news.
quests.explanation: FLUCTUATE captures the constant rising and falling of currency values, different from a full COLLAPSE, values that DISAPPEAR, or values that STABILIZE.

quests.definition: To develop gradually, especially over a long period of time.
quests.passage: Over millions of years, the ancestors of whales EVOLVEd from land-dwelling mammals into fully aquatic creatures.
quests.example: Over millions of years, the ancestors of whales EVOLVEd from land-dwelling mammals into fully aquatic creatures.
quests.exampleSentence: Over millions of years, the ancestors of whales EVOLVEd from land-dwelling mammals into fully aquatic creatures.
quests.contextSentence: Over millions of years, the ancestors of whales EVOLVEd from land-dwelling mammals into fully aquatic creatures.
quests.explanation: EVOLVE reflects the gradual biological change across generations, not vanishing suddenly, hibernating, or migrating.

quests.definition: To express disapproval of someone or something based on perceived faults.
quests.passage: Opposition lawmakers CRITICIZEd the new policy for failing to address rising housing costs.
quests.example: Opposition lawmakers CRITICIZEd the new policy for failing to address rising housing costs.
quests.exampleSentence: Opposition lawmakers CRITICIZEd the new policy for failing to address rising housing costs.
quests.contextSentence: Opposition lawmakers CRITICIZEd the new policy for failing to address rising housing costs.
quests.explanation: CRITICIZE shows lawmakers pointing out flaws in the policy, the opposite of endorsing it, ignoring it, or patenting it.
